changedContracts: Profile/API timestamp fields and signed policy validity timestamps require calendar-valid, serializable RFC3339 syntax; null optional profile timestamps and valid offsets/nanoseconds retain meaning.
Policy, envelope, installation and rotation fuzzing asserts accepted semantic bounds, unchanged input, exact signature/hash/key binding, revision replay rejection, expiry and offline non-enforcement.
Two new deterministic-key targets sign arbitrary mutated policy/rotation payloads to reach authenticated inner decoders; no native policy is installed.
STUN seeds include IPv4/IPv6 with and without fingerprints; packet bytes must remain unchanged.

Full profile cards use browser-managed offscreen rendering containment while retaining all DOM nodes. Existing keyboard coverage now exercises distant focus/edit/save/restore/filter/scroll/Tab with256seededprofiles; the performance workload and25caps are unchanged.

Synthetic populated-store profiles carry a valid nonzero saved revision so the distant-card test exercises a successful optimistic save; scrolling uses the selected profile identity rather than a sorted-position assumption.
Distant keyboard coverage selects the action-row Edit button explicitly so Tab must advance to the adjacent Duplicate action; the title remains a separate Edit control.
sdkMismatchControl: A mandatory test directly demonstrates the pinned SDK accepting +24:00 during JSON time parsing and refusing its JSON serialization, then requires application decode/sign/verify/installation to reject the malformed timestamp.

releaseGate.limit: Source dependency-graph validation and qualified component execution; no signed release or release-infrastructure disaster-recovery exercise.

mutationEvidenceMethod: Bounded Go JSON events are projected to fixed target IDs, hashes and numeric coordinator counters; no raw Output strings or corpus values are retained. Pass requires completed positive baseline, two workers, instrumented progress beyond baseline, >=30 reported seconds, package success, exit0, valid bounded stream and unchanged source. Counters are coordinator executions, not distinct inputs or complete coverage percentages.

localValidation.compileSourceBinding: 50 compile-only checks bind unchanged Go package sources;10 refreshed CLI compile checks bind changed embedded UI; no generated binary executed.

limits: Finite pure parser mutation and root regression do not prove exhaustive semantic coverage or long-duration stability.
Native fuzz/core execution is Windows/Linux AMD64/ARM64; the other six desktop targets are compile-only here.
Fixture signatures use deterministic test keys; no host certificates, organization signing keys, native policy installation, system networking changes or installed-product execution is involved.

The collector emergency signal on Windows owns only the root process handle; it does not qualify arbitrary descendant cleanup. Normal Go worker coordination and disposable hosted-job cleanup are distinct.
Browser acceptance uses source-built Linux fixtures with original budgets, not signed installed/managed endpoint qualification.
Signing identity, held macOS launch-preparation diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and broader enterprise desktop acceptance remain open.

A synthetic current-UI review still observes four timestamp acceptance mismatches against Go source semantics: optional-null, calendar-overflow, space-separator and extended-year. This remaining input-parity gap is recorded for the next implementation pass; current passing tests do not close it.

Offscreen containment preserves browser focus/search semantics; actual assistive-technology and all installed native desktop acceptance remain separate. One finite resource run does not establish long-duration stability or guarantee memory headroom on every endpoint.

priorAttempt.cause: Only ARM Firefox case52performance failed: sampled peak RSS1087455232bytes exceeded the unchanged1073741824byte cap. All51functional cases passed there and all52cases passed on the other five browser targets.
